We start with your business goal, not the tech — then ship clean, fast, SEO-ready sites that turn visitors into enquiries. Custom Next.js & React builds, e-commerce, Flutter mobile apps, and AI integrations from chatbots to multi-provider SaaS. Fixed-price quotes, async-friendly communication, and a live staging link for clients across the US, UK & Australia.

## Services

### Landing Page — from $600 (~AU$1,000) · ~2 weeks
Conversion-focused single page — copy structure, SEO basics, analytics, deployed.

### Business Website — from $2,000 (~AU$3,800) · 2–3 weeks
Multi-page site with CMS, contact/quote forms, booking integration, local SEO.

### E-Commerce Store — from $4,000 (~AU$5,000) · 4–6 weeks
Full store with Stripe checkout, inventory, admin dashboard, and order emails.

### AI / SaaS MVP — from $5,000 (~AU$6,500) · 6–8 weeks
Product build from zero — auth, billing, AI integrations, dashboard, launch-ready.

### Monthly Retainer — from $600/month
Ongoing partnership: priority access, unlimited revisions on active tasks, monthly deployments, performance monitoring, direct Slack/WhatsApp collaboration. Pause anytime.

## FAQ

**Q: What services do you offer exactly?**
A: We build websites, web apps, e-commerce platforms, and SaaS products — from design handoff to launch. Custom Next.js & React builds, Flutter mobile apps, AI integrations, Stripe & payment flows, admin dashboards, and performance audits.

**Q: How much does a website cost?**
A: Most projects fall between $600 and $15,000 USD depending on scope. A landing page starts at $600; a business website from $2,000; e-commerce from $4,000; an AI or SaaS MVP from $5,000. Fixed-price quotes upfront — never hourly billing.

**Q: What are the payment terms?**
A: 50% upfront to begin, 50% on completion. Larger projects can split into three milestones. We accept Wise, Stripe, PayPal, and bank transfer — works for clients in the US, UK, and Australia.

**Q: Do you work with international clients?**
A: Yes — most of our freelance work is for businesses in Australia, the US, and the UK. We handle timezones with async communication and scheduled calls, delivering on time regardless of location.

**Q: How long does a project take?**
A: Landing page: ~2 weeks. Business website: 2–3 weeks. E-commerce or SaaS: 4–6 weeks. You get a clear timeline with milestones in the proposal before we start.

**Q: Will I own the code?**
A: 100%. The code is yours, hosted wherever you like — Vercel, AWS, your own server. No subscriptions, no lock-in. Full repo handed over on completion.

**Q: Do you offer ongoing support after launch?**
A: The first 30 days post-launch are free. After that, monthly retainers start at $600/month for ongoing development, updates, and support.

## Technology Stack

**Frontend:** Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js, Redux
**Backend:** FastAPI, Node.js, Express, Python, REST APIs, WebSockets
**Mobile:** Flutter, Dart, BLoC, Provider, React Native
**Database:** MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, FAISS, Supabase
**AI / LLMs:** OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq, Mistral, LangChain
**Payments & DevOps:** Stripe, Razorpay, UPI, Vercel, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions
